QuestInfo.name: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Professor Peace
QuestInfo.0: All the rescues are complete. Talk to Cootie the Really Small at the Vacant Backyard.
QuestInfo.1: All the children have been rescued and returned. Talk to Headmistress Ivana to collect your reward.
QuestInfo.2: Headmistress Ivana has named you an honorary professor for rescuing the children. You're welcome at the Academy any time!

1.0: #b#h0##k, you have done a great deed for #bEllinel Fairy Academy#k. I would like to present you with a token of fairy appreciation.

yes.0: You have been bestowed the title of honorary professor at the #bEllinel Fairy Academy#k. You may visit any time you would like, but be sparing with your guests.
